description: This file defines the ManageController class, a controller in an ASP.NET Core web application that manages user profile functionalities such as viewing and updating account details, password management, external login associations, two-factor authentication setup, and recovery code handling.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing user account details, security settings, and multi-factor authentication.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display user account information.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update user profile details such as email and phone number.

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends a verification email to the user to confirm their email address.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Displays form for changing password (GET) or processes password change (POST).

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Displays form for setting password if none exists (GET) or processes setting password (POST).

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays external login providers linked to the user account.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates linking an external login provider to the user account.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Handles callback after external login provider authentication to link login.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes an external login provider from the user account.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays the two-factor authentication management view.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Shows warning page before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables two-factor authentication for the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Displays form to enable authenticator app for 2FA.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays recovery codes for 2FA backup.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Shows warning page before resetting authenticator app keys.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets authenticator app keys for the user.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before generating new recovery codes.

methods.name: AddErrors
methods.description: Adds identity errors to the model state.

methods.name: FormatKey
methods.description: Formats an unformatted key string for display.

methods.name: GenerateQrCodeUri
methods.description: Generates URI for QR code for authenticator apps.

methods.name: LoadSharedKeyAndQrCodeUriAsync
methods.description: Loads or resets shared key and QR code URI for authenticator app setup.
